skill.summary: Use when needing to search the web in AI coding tools or OpenClaw. Uses DuckDuckGo API without API key.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added detailed proxy support, including configuration by command line argument or environment variables (HTTP_PROXY, DDGS_PROXY).
- Updated documentation to include proxy usage instructions, priority order, and example formats (http, https, socks5).
- Expanded FAQ with common proxy troubleshooting tips.
- Removed pyproject.toml file from the project.
